entities.summary: Kushan Empire, a political institution in Pakistan during Indo-Greek, Kushan, and Gandharan Art (30–375). Grew from Parthian and Indo-Greek and Indo-Scythian Kingdoms. Led to the emergence of Kushan Empire and Gandharan Zenith and Gupta and White Hun Period.
